statement: For any valid placement of the original filled polygons, each active contained rectangle lies inside its original and the stock. Rectangles from distinct parts cannot overlap because the originals are disjoint; rectangles within each original have disjoint interiors by the exact integer comparisons. At any open vertical section the active rectangle heights are disjoint Y intervals inside the stock height, so their sum is at most2987000um. The horizontal-section argument similarly gives1487000um. Half-open scheduling endpoints preserve this necessary bound. Optional mode rectangles are active only for the unique selected legal mode. Constant rectangles for29 fixed first-sheet originals obey the same bound. No extra separation or bounding-box assumption is added.
local_containment_basis: Original transformed vertex coordinates represented exactly as decimal Fractions. Each rectangle lower-left point passes exact ray parity, and no source boundary segment intersects the closed rectangle by exact parametric clipping. Connectedness therefore places the whole rectangle strictly inside the original filled polygon.
